GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_GAZED_POWER.desc: Projection of Lostava will distort your HP and grant additional buffs. Lasts {Amount} turns.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_GREAT_BLOOD_SACR: You can only play [gold]Attack[/gold] cards for the rest of this turn.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_DEADLINE_POWER.d: After you play {Amount} more cards, die immediately. Playing [gold]Approaching Deadline[/gold] resets this to 13.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_REVERSAL_POWER.d: The next damage you take will occur {Amount} turns later. That damage is reduced by {Reduction}%.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_HEX_POWER.title: Hex
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_JUDGMENT_POWER.d: Destroyed in {Amount} turns. Each additional [gold]Judgment[/gold] brings destruction forward by 1 turn.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_ATROCITY_OPTIMIZ: Your next [gold]Attack[/gold] card deals {Amount}% more damage.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_GRAVITY_MOMENT_P: The next attack against you is redirected to all enemies for the same damage.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_MIND_OVER_MATTER: At turn start, gain {Amount} Energy. Double this if you began the turn Gazed.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_IDENTITY_THEFT_P: After combat, gain an additional card reward from the chosen character.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_IMPOSTOR_POWER.d: Whenever you play a card, gain {Amount} Gazed.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_FUNHOUSE_MIRROR_: At the start of each turn, add {Amount} copies of random cards in your hand to your hand.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_FORMLESS_DIVINIT: At turn start, choose 1 of {Amount} cards from other characters to add to your hand. They have “Synaesthesia: Costs 0.”
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_UNDERSTANDING_VO: At turn start, add {Amount} Shadow Missiles to your hand.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_TRANSDIMENSIONAL: Your Shadow Missiles also apply {Amount} Vulnerable.
At the start of each turn you begin Gazed, play the eaten Skill and Exhaust it.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_ETERNAL_PLANE_PO: For every 42 debuff stacks you apply, gain {Amount} Intangible.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_BLOOD_DEBT_POWER: Whenever you lose HP, apply that much Disintegration to ALL enemies {Amount} times.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_PERPETUAL_DECAY_: Gain 1 Gazed whenever Disintegration stacks triggered across all creatures reach the threshold.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_ETERNAL_WITHERIN: Whenever you play a card, apply {Amount} Disintegration to ALL enemies.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_ETERNAL_PLANE_PO: For every 42 debuff stacks you apply, gain {Amount} Intangible. Progress: {Progress}/42.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_POWER_PERPETUAL_DECAY_: For every {Threshold} stacks of Disintegration triggered across all creatures, gain 1 Gazed. Progress: {Progress}/{Threshold}.
